head: migration/electron
title: Migrate Slide Studio from Python to TypeScript and Electron
summary: Preserve the original editor and migrate workspace, AI, rendering, CLI and desktop hosting to TypeScript/Electron. Source startup uses npm install / npm start; packaged applications bundle Pandoc without requiring Python or uv. Preserve the Python reference on legacy/python.

Current arm64 DMG installed and verified; current Intel workflow passed under Rosetta. Windows installer built; runtime verification deferred.
Authenticated Codex and Antigravity editing/review/restoration verified.
Isolated packaged macOS app replacement, app-only removal and reinstall preserve authored files and saved workspace selection.
71 renderer state screenshots remain byte-identical after the rendering optimization.
remaining: User visual acceptance of application, PDF and locally prepared website
Automatic update UI/download/restart and signed update delivery are not implemented; manual replacement is verified
Native Intel hardware verification and explicitly deferred Windows verification
